title: Pork and Dumplings
description: A hearty Ukrainian dish made with pork and springy dumplings.
instructions: Heat the quaint vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned pork from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Return the browned pork to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the dumplings according to package instructions.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the pork and dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
